race.comment: MISO (11) is yet to strike through this campaign but is going just about as well as he ever has. Possesses a sharp turn of foot so will relish the anticipated tempo. Watch for him charging late. SNOOPY NOW (3) has returned in good order and was far from disgraced last start when tackling a tougher field at Caulfield. Drops in trip but will find this easier and gets an important 2kg claim. TOSEN WATER (9) doesn't win out of turn but is unbeaten over this track and trip and should be blending in nicely behind the strong tempo. THE STALKER (6) didn't give his rivals a sniff here last start when leading pillar-to-post. Drawn to advantage and keeps the 3kg claim to get him in light. Doubt he has as much of a picnic this time but he deserves respect. CIELAO (10) dropped out quickly first-up but usually improves with a run under her belt. Gets in light and draws to lead them up. Is another that will give a sight.
